subject: qbank.spec 'finishing a block, Lab values' fails axe target-size on WebKit phone ~1 in 2 (frozen-copy overlap, not S09)
body: Seen in my local smoke on webkit-phone-390 (and once on ipad-portrait): expectNoAxeViolations at qbank.spec.ts ~351 reports target-size on the Lab values sheet's button[aria-label=Close]. The screenshot shows the tutor view's sticky phone header ('Exit block 1 / 2' + arrows) painted over the sheet's title row: in the frozen static copy the <dialog> is not in the top layer, so the sticky header overlaps the Close button. Not caused by S09 (no S09 code in the tutor view or the Sheet). Options: run axe after closing the sheet, or give the frozen copy's open dialog a top z-index. Evidence: test-results/playwright/qbank-tutor-block-finishin-*-webkit-phone-390/test-failed-1.png in my worktree.
